**Aggregate ecosystem-level information.**

Finally, now that we have a dataset with all the identified individuals, let's proceed to create the dataset with ecosystem-level information (`ds_ecosystems`). There are three important information on how we proceed to create such a dataset:

1)  Individuals per volume of a species are computed as the average number of individuals present in a frame (total species frames / measured frames / measured volume). For example, let's say we want to measure the individuals of Ble. We detect individual A for 10 frames, individual B for 20 frames, and individual C for 30 frames. The individuals per volume of Ble will be:\
    \
    Ble individuals =\
    total species frames / measured frames / measured volume =\
    (10+20+30) frames / 125 frames / 0.0344 ml =\
    13.95 individuals / ml.

2)  Biomass per volume of a species is computed as the average biomass present in a frame (total species biomass / total species frames / measured frames / measured volume). For example, let's say we want to measure the biomass of Ble. We detect individual A with a biomass of 0.5 mm2/ml in 10 frames, individual B with a biomass of 1.0 mm2/ml in 20 frames, and individual C with a biomass of 1.5 mm2/ml in 30 frames. The biomass per volume of Ble will be:\
    \
    Ble biomass =\
    total species biomass / total species frames / measured frames / measured volume =\
    (0.5 + 1.0 + 1.5) mm2 / 125 frames / 0.0344 ml =\
    0.70 mm2 / ml.

3)  The information of different videos at time point 0 is averaged across videos for each ecosystems. For example, if the disconnected autotrophic ecosystem with ID = 1 at time point 0 had biomass of video 1 = 1 mm2 / ml, video 2 = 2 mm2/ml, video 3 = 1 mm2/ml, video 4 = 2 mm2/ml, video 5 = 1 mm2/ml, and video 6 = 1 mm2/ml, then biomass will be averaged across videos and will be 1.5 mm2/ml.

```{r}
ds_ecosystems[[threshold]] = ds_individuals %>%
  
  # To afterwards calculate the biomass and individuals of an ecosystem, summarise the bioarea and individuals of each species.

  group_by_at(vars(time_point:connection,
                   species)) %>%
  summarise(bioarea_mm2_per_ml = sum(bioarea_mm2_per_frame_per_ml),
            indiv_per_ml = sum(N_frames) / total_frames) %>%
  
  # To make it easier to plot and analyse the dataset, go from a long format (each row is a species of an ecosystem at a time point) to a wide format (each row is an ecosystem at a time point).

  pivot_wider(names_from = species,
              values_from = c(bioarea_mm2_per_ml, 
                              indiv_per_ml)) %>%
  rename(Ble_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Ble,
         Cep_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Cep,
         Col_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Col,
         Eug_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Eug,
         Eup_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Eup,
         Lox_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Lox,
         Pau_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Pau,
         Pca_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Pca,
         Spi_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Spi,
         Spi_te_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Spi_te,
         Ble_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Ble,
         Cep_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Cep,
         Col_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Col,
         Eug_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Eug,
         Eup_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Eup,
         Lox_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Lox,
         Pau_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Pau,
         Pca_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Pca,
         Spi_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Spi,
         Spi_te_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Spi_te)

# To avoid issues with column renaming, only rename the Tet columns where the threshold is set to 13. This is necessary because at a threshold of 40, Tet is no detected, resulting in no Tet columns being generated.

if(threshold == 13){
  
  ds_ecosystems[[threshold]] = ds_ecosystems[[threshold]] %>%
  rename(Tet_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Tet,
         Tet_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Tet)
}

# To have a single value at time point 0, average the values of all the videos. 

ds_ecosystems[[threshold]] = ds_ecosystems[[threshold]] %>%
  group_by_at(vars(time_point:connection)) %>%
  summarise(across(contains("bioarea_mm2_per_ml"), 
                   sum, 
                   na.rm = TRUE),
            across(contains("indiv_per_ml"), 
                    sum, 
                   na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
         # Calculate biomass and individuals of single ecosystems.  
    
         indiv_per_ml = sum(across(contains("indiv_per_ml"))),
         bioarea_mm2_per_ml = sum(across(contains("bioarea_mm2_per_ml"))),
         
         # To then sum bioarea between ecosystems of the same meta-ecosystem, get total bioarea. 
         
         bioarea_tot_mm2 = bioarea_mm2_per_ml * ecosystem_size_ml,
         
         # To study how the connection influenced biodiversity, calculate species richness, Shannon index, and evenness. 

         species_richness = specnumber(across(ends_with("_indiv_per_ml"))),
         shannon = diversity(across(ends_with("_indiv_per_ml")),
                             index = "shannon"),
         shannon = ifelse(species_richness == 0,
                          yes = NA,
                          no = shannon),
         evenness_pielou = shannon / log(species_richness)) %>%
  
  # To have a single value for each ecosystem at a time point, average video replicates.
  
  group_by(across(all_of(c("time_point", 
                           "day",
                           "system_nr",
                           "ecosystem_ID",
                           "metaecosystem",
                           "metaecosystem_type",
                           "ecosystem_type",
                           "ecosystem_size",
                           "ecosystem_size_ml",
                           "trophic_type",
                           "ecosystem_size_and_trophy",
                           "connection")))) %>%
  summarise(across(contains("_per_ml"), mean),
            across(contains("tot"), mean),
            species_richness = mean(species_richness),
            shannon = mean(shannon),
            evenness_pielou = mean(evenness_pielou)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # To tidy up, select useful columns.  

  select(time_point, 
         day, 
         system_nr, 
         ecosystem_ID, 
         metaecosystem, 
         metaecosystem_type, 
         ecosystem_type, 
         ecosystem_size, 
         ecosystem_size_ml,
         trophic_type, 
         connection,
         ecosystem_size_and_trophy,
         bioarea_mm2_per_ml,
         bioarea_tot_mm2,
         indiv_per_ml,
         species_richness,
         shannon,
         evenness_pielou,
         any_of(paste0(protist_species, "_bioarea_mm2_per_ml")),
         any_of(paste0(protist_species, "_indiv_per_ml")))
```
